D.quote: I am confident that, as Speaker of the House, he will unite the diverse coalitions of our Democratic Caucus nationwide to deliver a bold agenda for the American people.

Though I will no longer be a Member of Congress next year, I look forward to watching Speaker-designate Jeffries and his leadership team work hard for the American people, for this institution that he and I both cherish as the jewel in our democracy, and for the principles of equality and opportunity our Caucus continues to champion.
But step two is a recognition that the status quo is not acceptable, and we’ve got to build the best possible healthcare system for the American people.

R.quote: I am glad to see my colleagues in the Seante take action to end the bureaucracy and deliver on that vision for the American people.
As Chairman of the Republican Study Committee, I will continue championing meaningful legislation that reflects our conservative values and deliver real results for the American people.

And I am near certain that they would want members who are now privileged to hold this office to do everything in their power, in a bipartisan way, to get the Senate working again for the American people.

D.quote: As we prepare to enter the majority in the 120th Congress, House Democrats are focused not only on delivering meaningful solutions that lower costs and expand access to affordable housing, healthcare, and economic opportunities, but also on holding the Trump Administration accountable for leading us into an unlawful war, imposing unconstitutional tariffs, and the cruel and inhumane treatment of immigrants and citizens alike.
And fittingly, the 120th Congress will boast a record shattering 120 Democratic Congresswomen.

That’s why 57 incoming members and I have taken the Political Integrity Pledge to refuse corporate PAC money, to push for a ban on stock trading by Members of Congress, to ban lobbying by former Members of Congress for at least five years, and to support the overturning of Citizens United… We can do those things when we start the 120th Congress.

R.quote: As we look forward to the 120th Congress, the RSC’s mission is more important than ever as we continue to defend the principles of limited government, individual liberty, and economic opportunity that serve as the foundation for our shared conservative values.
Congressman Jay Obernolte has provided outstanding leadership as Policy Chair over the past two years, and I am pleased to continue to work alongside him in the 120th Congress.
With Republicans in the minority in the 120th Congress, the committee will nominate the conference’s Ranking Members.
